hook: 一邊跪著誇，一邊用睫毛從天花板瞪你。
script: 辦公室裡 sycophant／toady 會 fawn 巴結；對面座位坐著 arrogant、supercilious、imperious 的主管，睫毛好像長在額頭上往下掃視。

members.senseAnchor: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
members.speakLineEn: A sycophant praises power, not evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 諂媚者歌頌的是權力，不是證據。

members.senseAnchor: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage; try to gain favor by cringing or flattering
members.speakLineEn: He dismissed the aide as a political toady.
members.speakLineZh: 他把那名助理斥為政治馬屁精。

related.synonyms: sycophant, crawler, lackey, ass-kisser, fawn, truckle

members.speakLineEn: Junior analysts should not fawn over every fashion in theory.
members.speakLineZh: 初級分析師不該對每個理論時尚巴結奉承。

members.speakLineEn: An arrogant tone can sink an otherwise sound argument.
members.speakLineZh: 傲慢語氣可能毁掉本來站得住的論證。

members.speakLineEn: Her supercilious smile dismissed the objection.
members.speakLineZh: 她目空一切的笑把異議掃掉。

members.senseAnchor: having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy; ; ; ; ; ; ; - W.L.Shirer
members.speakLineEn: An imperious email rarely invites collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 專橫的郵件很少帶來合作。

related.synonyms: disdainful, haughty, lordly, overbearing, prideful, sniffy

reviewHooks: supercilious ≈ super + cilium（睫毛）在上往下看
pitfalls: fawn 另有『小鹿』義，考試多為動詞巴結
sycophant 諧音可記，但答題要回到『諂媚者』

qualityGate.note: Stage-1 promote: aligned with tract lesson template
